comment: Advisories that scripts/check-advisories.py may pass over, each with the
reason and the date somebody looked. Nothing is ignored without an entry,
and an entry that no longer matches a real finding fails the gate, so a
decision cannot outlive the thing it was about.
Every entry below is a transitive dependency of Tauri with no version this
project can choose. None is a vulnerability class: they are unmaintained or
unsound advisories. Re-check them whenever Tauri is upgraded.

accepted.reason: Build-time proc macro reached through glib-macros -> glib -> gtk -> muda -> tauri. It runs during compilation and no part of it is linked into the shipped binary. No release of the chain drops it; the fix has to come from Tauri's GTK stack.
Reached through atk -> gtk -> muda -> tauri, and only on Linux. The unsoundness is in glib's VariantStrIter, which this project never constructs. Tauri pins glib 0.18; upgrading is Tauri's to make.
Reached through urlpattern -> tauri-utils. Unmaintained, not vulnerable. Replacing it means Tauri moving off urlpattern.
Same urlpattern -> tauri-utils chain as RUSTSEC-2025-0075.
